name: rubi-promo
description: HyperFrames source of the Rubi promo video

scripts.check: node tools/build.mjs --check && python3 tools/fonts.py --check && HYPERFRAMES_NO_TELEMETRY=1 hyperframes check .
scripts.render: node tools/build.mjs && HYPERFRAMES_NO_TELEMETRY=1 hyperframes render . -o renders/promo-1920x1080.mp4 --crf 21 -w 3
scripts.render:vertical: node tools/build.mjs --layout portrait && HYPERFRAMES_NO_TELEMETRY=1 hyperframes render . -o renders/promo-1080x1920.mp4 --crf 21 -w 3; s=$?; node tools/build.mjs && exit $s
